Only visiting some [[Free For All|FFA]] servers like MBNet, Edome large and Edome small until [[2000]] when he got an ADSL connection and started really playing some FFA and [[2on2]]. Soon his first [[4on4]] experience came with [[Clan IGG]] when he was asked by [[Mega]] to join his clan to play in [[QWSM]] 2 - the result wasn't very successful. In [[2002]] after beating some [[Thangorodrim]] players at 2on2, [[Samgorod]] (founder of Thangorodrim) thought it was time for Katsku to start playing 4on4 with Thangorodrim. Then until [[2005]] he wandered in the shadows until [[Anza]] (who was carefully observed his skills in the battlefields) contacted and signed him up to [[Fraggers United]]. Early [[2008]] [[Fraggers United]]'s path was too unstable and full of pits so he decided to join [[Hippushnik]] as they needed an active player. In [[2010]] [[Hippushnik]] was put on hold and as a freelancer Katsku played EQL Season 11 with [[Satanic Slaughter Clan]]. Since then Katsku has walk the path of the soldier with [[Satanic Slaughter Clan]]. In [[2013]] [[Satanic Slaughter Clan]] was put on hold and Katsku returned to play with [[Fraggers United]].
